name: Trade Agreement 2
definition: Date and identification of a trade together with references to previous events in its life.

TradeDate.name: Trade Date
TradeDate.definition: Date at which the trading parties have agreed to amend or cancel a treasury trade.

NotificationIdentification.name: Notification Identification
NotificationIdentification.definition: Identification of a notification.This identification must be unique amongst all notifications of same type confirmed by the same party.

CommonReference.name: Common Reference
CommonReference.definition: Reference common to the parties of a trade.

AmendOrCancelReason.name: Amend Or Cancel Reason
AmendOrCancelReason.definition: Describes the reason for the cancellation or the amendment.

RelatedReference.name: Related Reference
RelatedReference.definition: Refers to the identification of a previous event in the life of a trade which is amended or cancelled.
